name: People Data Labs
summary: People and company data for developers.

flows.title: Run a batch enrich job
steps: Click New enrich job and choose a Person, Company, or IP job type from the dropdown.
Upload a CSV list for enrichment — using the Download CSV Template first means the columns map automatically.
Map each column in your list to the matching field using the dropdown in the PDL mapping column.
Set any optional parameters, such as Title case or Required fields, to control which records count as a match.
Review the job in the preview step, then click Start Enrichment to run it.

flows.title: View your API usage
steps: Click Usage in the left navigation menu to open the Usage page.
Use the dropdown menu in the Usage overview section to choose which PDL product to view usage for.
Click the date range dropdown to pick a period, then select a "View by" option to see the Usage chart broken down for that period.
Click the table icon in the top right to switch to the Usage table view.
Click Download to export the usage data.

flows.title: Create a usage alert
steps: Navigate to the Usage Alerts tab on the Settings page.
Select a product to configure an alert for.
Enter a threshold value between 1 and 100.
Click Add Alert; the alert appears in the table below.
